purpose: Three visibly middle-aged male whole-portrait visual candidates; no runtime installation or age-rule changes

reference_roles.role: Edit target; same project skin/hair painting, body/collar frame and costume
Secondary approved style/palette reference only, not a young face identity to copy

age_numbers: Approximate visual art directions only, not automatic chronological-age thresholds or cultivation/aging mechanics.

specs.name: 无须中年·清儒
specs.design: A refined CLEAN-SHAVEN man who visibly looks42–45, warm intelligent composure. A more substantial, softly squared adult jaw and chin; cheeks have defined adult planes and less youthful plumpness. Brow ridge and eye sockets subtly fuller/deeper, light upper-lid weight, fine outer-corner smile creases and a modest soft nasolabial turn. A naturally defined straight adult nose, slightly firmer alae, restrained thin closed lips with a calm near-smile. Very faint natural forehead expression texture, never a smooth teenage forehead or deeply lined old forehead. NO moustache, goatee, beard or stubble anywhere: maturity must be legible without facial hair. Keep the approved warm light skin tone healthy and unblemished. Hair naturally swept back from an open forehead into a simple LOW bound long tail behind shoulders; a few short lived-in temple wisps, no cheek curtains, no fancy pin or huge bun. This is an attractive mature scholar, not a 25-year-old romantic hero.
specs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / mature male character variant for the same modular Chinese cultivation game.
REFERENCE ROLES:
Image1 is the user-approved PROJECT MASTER and edit target. Preserve its exact 1024x1536 frontal head-to-waist composition, robe/collar/sash, body pose, lighting, background and painting material.
Image2 is another USER-APPROVED PROJECT PAINTING. Use it as evidence of the same warm pale skin, soft charcoal hair, delicate gongbi-and-wash rendering and attractive restrained eye scale. Do not copy its young face or loose asymmetric hairstyle.
REQUIRED CHANGE: draw a visibly MIDDLE-AGED handsome Chinese male with the specific mature face design below. The face itself must clearly read middle-aged, through adult bone/soft-tissue planes and modest age detail. This is not a 20–25-year-old with a pasted moustache, random wrinkle texture or a few lines stamped onto the old baby-smooth face.
STYLE LOCK: exactly this project's delicate semi-realistic Chinese gongbi / light ink-and-wash finish, fine softly painted natural pigment, muted warm ivory paper backdrop. Same warm LIGHT ivory-peach skin family across forehead/face/ears/neck; no tan, pale gray, bleached pink, orange/bronze or weather-beaten color change. Same deep warm charcoal-black matte head hair and facial hair with fine separated strands and weak warmgray highlights. NO gray/white/silver hair, shiny metallic highlights, photorealistic pores, cracked stone skin, hard manga/cel outlines, plastic3D or cosmetic makeup.
AGE BEAUTY: visibly mature and dignified while remaining attractive and healthy. Use subtly deeper orbital planes/heavier upper-lid tissue, adult cheek/jaw planes, light natural nasolabial definition and a few very faint genuine expression lines. Keep age changes coherent with soft shading, not dark etched wrinkle lines or a dirty texture overlay. No skeletal gauntness, hanging jowls, enormous eyebags, harsh forehead furrows, senile frailty, villain glare or ugly caricature.
EYES: small-to-medium ADULT MALE scale, regular brown irises partly covered by upper lids, fine sparse short lashes and soft lid folds. Both sides must have naturally CLOSE eye opening/iris size/height; no obvious unequal eyes, one round staring eye and one slit, heavy eyeliner, long sharp dark outer wings or excessive sleepy squinting. Mature gaze is conveyed by planes and expression, not giant irises.
COMPATIBLE COMPOSITION: maintain the reference's same head height, head/body ratio, centered frontal gaze, skull scale, ear level, connected neck and collar contact. No head tilt/turn/zoom. Within that compatible overall frame, allow a mature, slightly squarer lower jaw and adult facial contours instead of the youthful pointed V-chin. Face outer shape must age coherently; neck/shoulder/collar frame stays. These are guide positions only, never draw markers.
KEEP the SAME deep muted jade-green robe, ivory crossed inner collar, pale-gold botanical/cloud embroidery, folds and cloth waist sash from Image1. Do not replace costume with armor, black cloak or a new profession outfit. No added weapons, books, jewelry or conspicuous crown. Hair silhouette can vary with the described design but stays restrained and avoids two matching long cheek/chest curtains.

specs.name: 短须中年·沉稳
specs.design: An attractive composed sturdy man who visibly looks45–48. Adult cheekbones, a modestly broader square jaw and fuller mature midface, strong but softly modeled brow/forehead plane, subtly weighted upper lids and light age folds at the outer eye and nose. Nose has a firmer bridge and natural adult rounded tip. Level relaxed mouth, quietly dependable expression, not angry or sternly squinting. Facial hair: a neat SHORT charcoal moustache and SHORT closely trimmed chin/jaw beard, fine coherent painted strands, clean mouth corners with lips readable. No large black beard block, modern barber fade, giant bushy whiskers or gray hair. Facial proportions, soft-tissue planes and age detail must independently look middle-aged under the beard. Hair neatly swept backward into a modest high half-bound knot and narrow long posterior tail with a plain dark cloth tie. Open temples and chest, no bilateral dangling locks. Same matte delicate hair material and same warm light skin as the project.

specs.name: 长髯中年·儒雅
specs.design: A dignified elegant male scholar who visibly looks50–52, still healthy, attractive and strong, clearly middle-aged rather than elderly. Slightly longer mature face with defined adult cheek planes, refined firm jaw, subtly deeper sockets and heavier but alert upper lids; gently level brows, fine crow's-feet only at actual outer corners, light nasolabial and mouth-corner definition and extremely faint forehead expression lines. No hollow skull, severe sagging, heavy eyebags, old-man deep wrinkles or excessive decrepitude. A calmly observant, mild clear gaze and relaxed natural thin lips. Beard: a restrained narrow charcoal moustache and a softly flowing slim chin beard reaching the upper chest, naturally separated fine strands, not a dense square beard or wispy cartoon Fu-Manchu. Keep the mouth/nose structures readable, same charcoal-black family with no whitening. His face structure must still look around50 when imagined clean-shaven, not a smooth young face carrying a beard. Hair with restrained slightly irregular open side part, tucked around ears and gathered into a simple modest rear knot and straight back length. No broad forehead curtain, no duplicate long chest locks, no ornate crown/pin. Preserve source robe and posture exactly.
